<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Syracuse, NY
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://breakthroughdesign.com">https://breakthroughdesign.com</a>
</p>

<div>
<h1>Senior Creative &amp; Web Designer Position (Contract)</h1>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong>Breakthrough Design Group Inc.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Job Description</strong></p>
<p>Breakthrough is looking for a Senior Creative &amp; Web Designer to work on a contract basis (10-30 hours/week, with potential for full-time hire).&nbsp; Your primary responsibilities will include:</p>
<p>A zeal to live, and to share life with those around you.&nbsp; To better understand the human condition, it's unique struggles, and strengths.&nbsp; And for each individual client - an excitement to make lives better, to understand and improve others' pain points, and weaknesses, and to want to help them grow and change the world via their web, creative, and digital experiences.</p>
<p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Demonstrable (Currently Live) Web Design</span></li>
<li>Demonstrable Creative Direction (or demonstrable passion for it) - We are working with you for your expertise and would love for you to do what you do best. We will provide the content, goals, materials etc, and we would love for you to create the experience.</li>
<li>Mobile &amp; Responsive Design</li>
<li>UI/UX Design Experience</li>
<li>Figma / Sketch Experience (or comparable web design tool to provide to devs for buildout)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Pluses:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Brand Design</li>
<li>Illustration, Icon, Vector Design</li>
<li>Formal education in (or love for) art or design</li>
<li>(Optional) Love for Colors, Typography, Patterns, Psychology&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Location &amp; Benefits:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Work from wherever you like:</strong> Position is remote (We have been remote since 2009)</li>
<li><strong>Work whenever you like:</strong> BDG exists to ensure the enduring health and happiness of our teams, clients, and our families. Each team member creates their own schedule, that may evolve and adjust as life demands. <strong>As long as we have some regular, planned overlap time (maybe 1-2 hours ideally between 8-12pm EST, maybe 1-2x/week</strong> <strong>depending on project volume</strong>), work is on schedule, and clients are happy, you may work whenever you would like.</li>
<li><strong>For the most part, work however you like:</strong> Make this as profitable, innovative, and enjoyable as you'd like: We will set baseline requirements for what must happen, how it must look, and function. How you meet those requirements, tools you use, how you work, how little or much you work - is totally up to you. We encourage you to make this as profitable, innovative, and enjoyable as possible for you.</li>
<li><strong>Partnership / Commission / Bonus Pay</strong>&nbsp;- Ideally if our relationship deepens, we would like to continue to grow with you for years to come, so bonus pay, commission, and eventual partnership is the track we encourage our team to take.</li>
<li><strong>We look forward to making this a lifestyle career for you, and changing the world together.</strong></li>
</ul>
<h3>To Apply:</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Applications will only be accepted at <a href="https://breakthroughdesign.com/join">breakthroughdesign.com/join</a> (*Note: Applications received through outside sites eg. WWR, Indeed, Glassdoor, or LinkedIn will not be seen by hiring committee)</strong></li>
</ul>
</div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/breakthrough-design-group-senior-creative-web-designer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/breakthrough-design-group-senior-creative-web-designer</a></p>

      <title>ELITEBRAIN: Photographer – AI Image Quality Evaluation (Remote, U.S.)</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>

      <category>Design</category>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Pembroke Pines, Florida, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.elitebrain.ai">https://www.elitebrain.ai</a>
</p>

<div><p></p><h2>Company Description</h2></div><div><p>Our client is seeking photography professionals to support an initiative focused on evaluating and improving visual data quality for next-generation artificial intelligence systems. The project combines human creative expertise with detailed image assessment to help improve AI-generated visual content.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p></div><div><p></p><h2>Job Description</h2></div><div><p>We are seeking Photographers for a remote, contract opportunity supporting the evaluation and improvement of visual data used to train next-generation AI systems.</p><p>You will apply your photography expertise to compare original photographs with AI-generated images, identify visual inconsistencies, and provide detailed written feedback. No prior experience in AI is required.</p><p>Responsibilities:<br>
• Upload your own original photographic content through a secure digital platform.<br>
• Compare original photographs with AI-generated counterparts, identifying differences, visual flaws, and artifacts.<br>
• Evaluate lighting, composition, perspective, texture, and overall image quality.<br>
• Document findings using accurate technical vocabulary and clear, concise written English.<br>
• Participate in iterative review cycles and adjust feedback as project guidelines evolve.<br>
• Collaborate with the project team to clarify requirements and share observations.<br>
• Maintain current profile information to support project tracking and communication.</p><p>Location: Remote within the United States.<br>
Engagement: Independent contractor.<br>
Compensation: USD $21–$65 per hour.</p></div><div><p></p><h2>Qualifications</h2></div><div><p>• Demonstrated background in photography, digital imaging, photo editing, graphic design, or a related creative discipline.<br>
• Strong understanding of lighting, composition, perspective, texture, and image quality.<br>
• Exceptional attention to detail and a meticulous, methodical approach to image comparison.<br>
• Strong written English skills, including accurate spelling, grammar, and technical descriptions.<br>
• Ability to provide clear, concise feedback and adapt to evolving project guidelines.<br>
• Ability to upload original photographic content that you own.<br>
• Effective communication and collaboration skills.<br>
• Must be based in the United States.</p><p>Preferred:<br>
• Experience in image evaluation, image annotation, or quality assurance for digital or AI-related projects.</p><p>No prior experience in artificial intelligence is required.</p></div><div><p></p><h2>Additional Information</h2></div><div><p>• Work arrangement: Remote. Candidates must be based in the United States.<br>
• Engagement type: Independent contractor.<br>
• Compensation: USD $21–$65 per hour.<br>
• Project focus: Evaluation of original photographs and AI-generated images to support the improvement of AI systems.<br>
• Original content: Participants will upload their own original photographs through a secure digital platform.<br>
• Prior AI experience is not required.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elitebrain-photographer-ai-image-quality-evaluation-remote-u-s">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elitebrain-photographer-ai-image-quality-evaluation-remote-u-s</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Keeper Security: Creative Localization Specialist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Product Designer and Product Design</skills>
      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US
</p>

<p><strong>Description</strong></p>
<p>Keeper is hiring a detail-oriented Creative Localization Specialist to manage the localization of global creative assets across multiple languages and design platforms. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.</p>
<p>Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help deliver high-quality creative experiences to a global audience.</p>
<p><strong>About Keeper</strong></p>
<p>Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at<a href="http://keepersecurity.com"> KeeperSecurity.com</a>.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>As a Creative Localization Specialist, you will adapt existing creative assets into multiple languages and formats while ensuring accuracy, consistency, and adherence to Keeper’s brand and design standards. Reporting to the Director of Localization, you will work closely with the design team and Head of Product Design to manage localization workflows, resolve design challenges, and deliver polished assets across print, digital, and motion formats.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Localize creative assets in Adobe Creative Suite (primarily, but not limited to InDesign and AfterEffects), Figma, and motion graphics files for 16+ target languages</li>
<li>Manage design localization workflows by submitting translation requests through Smartling and applying completed translations to Figma and other design files</li>
<li>Adapt layouts, spacing, formatting, and visual elements to accommodate language-specific text expansion and contraction</li>
<li>Maintain consistency in terminology, brand guidelines, formatting, and design standards across localized assets</li>
<li>Conduct quality assurance reviews to confirm accuracy, formatting, visual integrity, and overall design quality</li>
<li>Support the localization of digital, print, presentation, video, and other creative materials</li>
<li>Manage localization workflows, timelines, file handoffs, and deliverables across multiple languages and file types</li>
<li>Collaborate with the Director of Localization, translation team, designers, and other stakeholders to identify and resolve localization challenges</li>
<li>Maintain organized asset libraries, file naming conventions, version control, and final deliverables</li>
<li>Track project status and communicate updates, risks, and outstanding needs to relevant stakeholders</li>
<li>Support continuous improvements to localization processes, templates, and production workflows</li>
<li>Participate in special projects for the Localization, Design, and Product Design teams</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years of experience in creative production, localization, graphic design, or a related field</li>
<li>Proficiency in Adobe InDesign and Figma</li>
<li>Basic understanding of motion graphics tools, such as Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere, or similar platforms</li>
<li>Experience working with localization workflows and multilingual design best practices</li>
<li>Ability to work accurately with translated content across multiple languages</li>
<li>Strong understanding of layout, typography, spacing, formatting, and visual design principles</li>
<li>Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality</li>
<li>Strong organizational and project management skills</li>
<li>Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and file types simultaneously</li>
<li>Strong communication and collaboration skills</li>
<li>Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment</li>
<li>Ability to work effectively autonomously and as part of a cross-functional team</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Localization, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience with localization management platforms or computer-assisted translation tools</li>
<li>Familiarity with right-to-left language considerations</li>
<li>Knowledge of design-to-code handoff processes</li>
<li>Experience working in a SaaS, technology, cybersecurity, or global organization</li>
<li>Experience supporting video, motion graphics, or multimedia localization</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, Dental &amp; Vision (Inclusive of domestic partnerships)</li>
<li>Employer Paid Life Insurance &amp; Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life</li>
<li>Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance</li>
<li>401k (Roth/Traditional)</li>
<li>A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)</li>
<li>Above market annual bonuses</li>
</ul>
<p>Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.</p>
<p>Classification: Non-exempt</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="pf0"><strong><span class="cf0">Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice</span></strong></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).</span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1"> 1. </span><strong><span class="cf0">Data We Collect</span></strong></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Information You provide:</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Application responses and uploaded documents</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Information We generate:</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Interview notes, assessments, communications</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Scheduling information</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Information From Others:</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">References (with your consent, before final offer)</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Public professional profiles</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Background verification (post offer)</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1"> Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1"> 2. </span><strong><span class="cf0">How We Use Your Data</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Assess your application and suitability</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Manage interviews and recruitment workflow</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Comply with employment law obligations</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1"> 3. </span><strong><span class="cf0">Legal Basis</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1"> 4. </span><strong><span class="cf0">Who We Share Information With</span></strong></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Internal: </span></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.</span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Third Parties:</span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Service providers who assist with:</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Background verification vendors (post offer)</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Recruitment agencies (where applicable)</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.</span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1"> 5. </span><strong><span class="cf0">International Transfers</span></strong></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws. </span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">6. </span><strong><span class="cf0">Security</span></strong></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.</span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">7. </span><strong><span class="cf0">Retention</span></strong></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it. </span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Exceptions:</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">You're hired (transfers to employee records)</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1"> 8. </span><strong><span class="cf0">Your Rights</span></strong></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Object to or restrict processing</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Withdraw consent (where applicable)</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Request data portability</span></li>
<li class="pf1"><span class="cf1">Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.</span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1"> 9. </span><strong><span class="cf0">Automated Decisions</span></strong></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.</span></p>
<p class="pf0"><span class="cf1">10. </span><strong><span class="cf0">Contact</span></strong><span class="cf1"> - Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/keeper-security-creative-localization-specialist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/keeper-security-creative-localization-specialist</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong>  -REMOTE, BULGARIA-
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.</p></div><p>Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We’re here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows, and rapidly build new secure solutions, using simple no-code tools. We’re revolutionaries – so for us, changing the way the world works is all in a day’s work.</p>
<p>As a global leader in Intelligent Work Management with a market cap of $10bn, we’ve continued to scale our engineering presence internationally. Since expanding into Bulgaria in October 2024, we’ve grown to a team of 75+ engineers. As we continue expanding into Bulgaria and build our operation, we're searching for a talented and motivated Engineering Manager. Our business is built on finding exceptional talent and empowering them to build and improve our service offerings.</p>
<p>You will work remotely from Bulgaria and will be reporting to an Engineering Director.</p>
<p><strong>You Will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Manage a team of software engineers to deliver great products to our customers</li>
<li>Oversee the development and success of one or more products</li>
<li>Lead, coach, and inspire your team to achieve quality software</li>
<li>Collaborate with partners across the company, including product management, UX, and customer teams</li>
<li>Establish lean engineering processes that use collaboration and rapid iteration to build the right product for the right problems</li>
<li>Hire and grow your team by promoting engineering excellence and career development</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>You Have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have 8+ years of software engineering experience and 3+ years managing software engineering teams.</li>
<li>You have deep software development skills in at least one systems development language, such as Java, Go, C++, or Python.</li>
<li>You have experience with modern technology stacks with a passion for building scalable, highly available customer-facing cloud applications.</li>
<li>You have experience in a technology that you're personally excited about, such as distributed systems, systems automation, and cloud technologies.</li>
<li>You like to dive in, learn new things, and want to build outstanding products.</li>
<li>Legally eligible to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis.</li>
<li>Proficiency in English is required.</li>
</ul>
<p>Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Get to Know Us:</strong></p>
<p>At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.</p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong></p>
<p>Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.&nbsp;</p>
<p>If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>Why Join Our Mission?</strong></p>
<p>At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. <p><strong>Freedom and Flexibility:</strong> At Yubico, we want you to be your most productive selves whether you decide to work 100% from home or choose to work hybrid/onsite. The way we balance the fast-paced demands of a high-growth company and sustainability is making rest a priority.</p>
<p><strong>Yubico Values: </strong>We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work <a href="https://www.yubico.com/why-yubico/secure-it-forward/">here</a>).</p>

<p>Yubico is looking for a dynamic, experienced Account Director to join our strategic named accounts sales team.&nbsp; This individual will work with our rapidly growing customer base and prospects to drive Yubico revenue and enterprise utilization.&nbsp; We welcome a strong individual who has deep knowledge of the enterprise market.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Revenue booked is a critical measure, but this role is so much more. It's also about changing the world and bringing Trust back into our digital world for customers, partners and their customers.</p>

<p><strong>Role Purpose:</strong> The Machine Learning Engineer IV will play a critical role in advancing Jumio's Fraud team's mission to develop and enhance state-of-the-art solutions for fraud detection for ID verification purposes. <p><strong>Role Value:</strong> As a Machine Learning Engineer IV at Jumio, you will have the opportunity to significantly impact the security and user experience of our ID verification solutions. Your expertise in deep learning and computer vision will drive the development of innovative algorithms that keep Jumio at the forefront of the industry. <h3>&nbsp;</h3>
<p><strong>Example Responsibilities</strong></p>
<p>.&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Develop, maintain, and own key fraudulent CV models of Jumio, which shapes the whole fraud product offering of Jumio.&nbsp;</li>

<div>
<p>Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. <p>We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. <p><strong>Why You’ll Love This Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows.</p>
<p>This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform.</p>
<p><strong><br>As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…</strong></p>

<li>Share work early and often through critiques and working sessions. Give and receive specific, constructive feedback.</li>
<li>Use research and product evidence to prioritize opportunities, evaluate concepts, and improve shipped workflows.</li>
<li>Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners.</li>
<li>We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.</li>

<li>Experience designing AI-assisted, agentic, conversational, or other emerging interaction models.</li>
<li>Expert Figma skills, including advanced prototyping and design documentation.</li>
<li>Demonstrated expertise working in and contributing to design systems. You know when to use existing patterns and when to extend them thoughtfully.</li>
<li>Understanding of AI tools and AI UX interaction models is required. You can design experiences where AI assists, recommends, generates, investigates, or takes action while preserving user understanding, control, and trust.</li>
<li>Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative and changing environment.</li>
<li>Strong communication, facilitation, and problem solving skills, including the ability to make progress when information is incomplete.</li>
<li>A portfolio with case studies that show your role, process, decisions, collaboration, and outcomes. Candidates will be asked to present and discuss previous work.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Highly desired</strong>:
<ul>
<li>Familiarity with research tools such as Dovetail, including transcripts, tagging, themes, repositories, and insights.</li>
<li>Experience with security data, detections, alerts, investigations, threat intelligence, telemetry, data pipelines, or analytical workflows.</li>
